verdict.rationale: Google's docs walk users through enrollment (sign in, enroll key, detect account has a key, follow sign-in steps) and cover platform-specific setup like Linux udev rules and NFC/cable connection steps, giving a reasonably guided first-time setup. However, there's no dedicated setup app/wizard beyond web instructions, and community reports describe real friction (Chrome-only enrollment issues, failure to pair Bluetooth key with a Mac) that undercuts a smooth guided experience on some platforms. Missing for 10: a purpose-built setup app/wizard, video walkthrough, and independent confirmation that setup goes smoothly across all major platforms.
